theorems.statement: ∀ (a b c d : ℝ) (H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), c < d → IntegrableOn H (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo c d) → (∀ ψ l : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → ContDiff ℝ 1 l → tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioo c d → tsupport l ⊆ Ioo a b → ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, deriv ψ p.2 * l p.1 * H p = 0) → ∀ᵐ t, t ∈ Ioo a b → ∃ k : ℝ, ∀ᵐ α, α ∈ Ioo c d → H (t, α) = k
